Name: Obadiah, Prince of Judah
Summary: Obadiah was one of the princes Jehoshaphat sent in his third year to teach in the cities of Judah.
KeyStory: Jehoshaphat sent his princes, including Obadiah, to teach in the cities of Judah.
LifeLesson: God's law taught throughout the land, and willing service under a faithful king, strengthened Judah.
